# OLYMPUS v0.0.10, "Bang": the build sheet

Written 2026-11-08 for the round's three implementers (supp, scene, face) and the lead who integrates: the contract between roles building in parallel without talking. Where it is silent the docs decide (DESIGN.md and the user's rules, then TECH §1.3 on implementation, then COMBAT §5 and §25.18 and the sections they cite); my own choices are marked (my call) and every disagreement settled here is in §8.

**The release.** ROADMAP §4.2's 0.0.7c row, its second patch, shipped as v0.0.10: `test-stress`, "Bang" (the Tests menu's entry after "Three bangs"), on the 25 m bay's 7 m point and its turners, the shooter **in ear defenders** (the issue's, kept on). Five strings with the coach's noise: **(1) calm**; **(2) the din**: an air horn and thirty blanks fired by the coach at your shoulder; **(3) a bang called**: the coach shouts "Bang!" and throws one (forewarned); **(4) three bangs unannounced**, 1 s apart, the turn 2 s after the third; **(5) the same on the coach's one-round magazine**: the Pair runs you dry, the RELOAD is done under the chaos, and **a second turner turns 1.5 to 2.5 s into the RELOAD** (the hardening design's question 9, answered yes for this scene). **Breathe** is a step (COMBAT §5.2). The sheet picker and "Again as …" every sheet on the same seed. **The hit card on turners** (VIEWS §7.7, the user's answer A: the doll in colour; belief, then truth), with its three gallery samples. The inoculation counter is fed at each string's end (fixed on test sheets). BODY §9.3's stress from felt's band. Scored on three aspects: **the chaos**, **the contrast**, **the hands**.

**What the user must feel.** The din is a fight's noise: the horn, the blanks' flashes and cracks at your left ear, the recruit's picture closing a little, his rolls a point or two worse, the tier one untouched. The called bang flinches the recruit under a second and nobody else: a warning is worth having. Three bangs in ear defenders still pin the recruit (felt about 72) and leave the tier one at 0. On the last string the recruit's RELOAD fails more often than not while a second man turns; the tier one's reloads like calm. Breathe drains the chaos twice as fast for 4 s and is never free. "Again as Tier one" makes the gulf plain. Never a dead end; every DI line names a row the panel has, and T does it.

**The user's rules hold over every section** (DESIGN.md): the bay authored, everything on it procedural from the seed on named streams; 16 px/m chibi; every image and sound made by code; nothing pops; graphics over words, no overlapping UI; AZERTY labels on physical codes. **test-handling (100/100/100), test-range, test-pairs and "Three bangs" as built must not get worse**: their bots to the tick, their papers and words (§3.3).

**Rules of the round**: only your own files (§1); a change in a file you do not own goes in your report as the exact edit; no commits, branches, tags, pushes, `release.sh` or `promote.sh`; never `.play/`, :8200, :8201, `../longhaul`, `../tradecraft` (read only) or `docs/research/`; scratch under `/private/tmp/claude-501/olympus-build/r10/<role>/`. **Ports**: supp 8231, scene 8232, face 8233; the integrator 8236; reviews 8237 to 8239; `OLYMPUS_TEST_PORT` for `tests/browser.mjs`; kill every server. Tests: `node tests/run.mjs '<file> ›'`, `QUICK=1 QUICK_LIMIT_S=300 node tests/run.mjs`; a CPU or frame ceiling that fails under load is rerun alone before it is believed (say so). Look at what you build (`node tools/shot.mjs`, 16 px/m). Docs and CHANGELOG.md are the lead's: return CHANGELOG bullets and doc items (file, section, exact change).

**Interfaces first.** Each role first writes §2's exports as stubs with the shapes given, then fills them; test against your own stub of a dependency until it is real, and say so. **Merge order**: supp, scene, face; `QUICK=1 node tests/run.mjs` after each.

## 2. Interfaces

JavaScript; `state` the saved state, `bus` the core bus, `pid` a person id, times integer game ms, positions in the area's frame (x east, z south, metres), man-target points in cm from the A zone's centre (`paper.js PAPERS.man`, y down). Pure unless marked **w**.

### 2.1 supp: `src/sim/combat/supp.js` and where it reaches

```js
// the inputs v0.0.9 built, now posted (COMBAT §5.1; each returns [{ who, pts, k, felt }] for the persons written)
shotNoise(state, bus, { id, x, z, byId, atMs, indoor = false, blank = false }) → [...]      // w; a shot's report at the muzzle (x, z):
  // 'muzzle' (inputPts) to every actor within MUZZLE_M of the muzzle but the shooter; indoors 'roomShot' to every other in the room
  // (FLASH_REACH_M until PLACES gives rooms); kOf as built (ear defenders ×0.6). blank: true changes nothing in the points: BLANKS_K is
  // the harness's near-miss tone in place of a crack, never a blank's report (§8 item 6). Called this round by the stress course's
  // coach only (§8 item 5); the player's own rounds post nothing (own: 0)
dinOf(state, bus, { id, x, z, s = 1, atMs }) → [...]     // w; 'din' (DIN_PTS_S × s) to every actor within DIN_M; folded once a whole second
bang(state, bus, { id, x, z, atMs, byId = null, kind = 'training', indoor = false, called = false, call = null }) → [...]   // as built, plus:
  // call { x, z, atMs }: the thrower's "Bang!"; a person who heard it (hearsVoice(state, pid, call, call.atMs)) within CALL_HEARD_MS
  // before atMs is 'forewarned' (×0.6, the startle ×0.5, no flash if facing away; COMBAT §5.1); otherwise as built. called stays 'prepared'
// Breathe (COMBAT §5.2): the pool's decay × BREATHE_K over [fromMs, untilMs], in the closed form
suppAt(rec, ms) → points    // as built, plus the window: max(0, supp − rate × (dec(ms) + (BREATHE_K − 1) × overlap([d0, ms], [rec.breatheFromMs,
  // rec.breatheUntilMs])) / 1000), d0 = suppAtMs + SUPP_GRACE_MS, dec(ms) = max(0, ms − d0); absent fields read as no window
breatheOffer(state, pid = playerId(state), ms) → { ok, why, up }   // ok: felt ≥ BREATHE_FROM, not startled, no window open (pendingOf),
  // not breathing; why 'calm' | 'startled' | 'taking in' | 'breathing'; up: a threat of the string stands facing (the row marked "! he's up")
breatheStart(state, bus, pid, atMs) → { fromMs, untilMs }   // w; folds nothing (the closed form carries it); writes breatheFromMs/UntilMs;
  // the 'breathe' fact 'start'
breatheEnd(state, bus, pid, atMs, { cut = false }) → { shedPts }   // w; untilMs = atMs on a cut; the fact 'end'; the log entry
  // "Breathed 4.0 s: the chaos 79 → 63." (shedPts the extra drain Breathe gave over plain decay, to 0.01)
// BODY §9.3: stress from felt's band, in closed form
stressGainOf(rec, H, fromMs, toMs) → points   // ∫ SUPP_STRESS_PER_S[band(felt(t))] dt over [fromMs, toMs], felt(t) = feltFrom(suppAt(rec, t), H):
  // the band's crossing times solved on the linear pieces (grace, plain, Breathe); pure, exact to 1e-9
foldStress(state, bus, pid, ms) → points      // w; addStress(state, pid, stressGainOf(rec, hardOf(state, pid, from), from, ms), ms),
  // from = rec.stressAtMs ?? rec.suppAtMs; rec.stressAtMs = ms; called before every input written, at a startle's end, by suppSecond
suppSecond(state, input, bus, ctx)            // w; people domain's 'second' (lived; skips fold once at their end, the same total): every actor
  // with a block, at whole multiples of SUPP_STRESS_FOLD_MS of the game clock, foldStress; the first fold at which the pool reads 0 is the last
  // (stressAtMs dropped)
noteExposure(state, pid, { feltPeak, teacher, atMs })   // as built; now called by the scene at each finished noisy string (§2.2)
```

- **`body/stress.js`** (taken): `addStress(state, pid, pts, ms)` (w), the body's own path for an instant change (the one the shower's calm and an accident's +10 take: the record brought to `ms`, `stress.v` raised, at most 100, rounded as the record rounds). The toll's `frayed` (75) then reads it, as built. The acute inputs of BODY §9.1 × (1 − H / 100) wait for something on a range that posts one (§7).
- **`shooting.js`** (taken): `stepsOf` gains the single `breathe` ("Breathe · 4.0 s") when `breatheOffer().ok`: a fixed row (first page) with no threat facing, else a single paged with the rest and marked `warn: 'up'` ("! he's up", never struck; pillar 3). Its plan: four sub-steps `breathe` of `BREATHE_SUB_MS` (in, hold, out, hold), no roll, **never × `timeK`** (breathing is not the hands: §8 item 11), `breatheStart` at its start, `breatheEnd` at its end or cut; a startle cuts it at its sub-step's end as any step (built). `breatheAction(state, bus)`: in the mode `chooseStep('breathe')`, out of it `liveStep('breathe')`.
- **`arms/domain.js`** (taken): `actions.breathe` calls `breatheAction` (the act gate refuses it in a window or a startle, as built).
- **`contact.js`** (taken): a sighting that opens a window while a Breathe runs cuts it at its sub-step's end (`d.cut`, as the startle does). Nothing else moves.
- **`people/domain.js`** (taken): `second: (s, i, b, c) => { …as built; suppSecond(s, i, b, c); }`.

### 2.2 scene: `src/sim/scenarios/stress.js`, the engine's hooks, the instinct

**The engine** (§8 item 2): test-stress runs on pairs.js's engine with `armoury.range.course = 'pairs'` (so every hook of handling.js, shooting.js, look.js, main.js and the instinct that reads the pairs course holds) and **`armoury.range.stress`** present; that field alone selects the stress course's strings, sequence and noise. Calm test-pairs and "Three bangs" never carry it.

```js
testStress(state, { at, setup, tier })   // the fill: as testPairs (the barracks, 11:00, the lane by drawLane(seed, 'stress'), the 7 m point,
  // utilities, the test sheet, the 'range-pairs' issue with its ear defenders worn, the coach at your left shoulder), magazines 10, 10 and 1,
  // startRange on the pairs course, R.stress = { strs: [], plan: [], attempt: 0, inoc: [] }; setup null | 'standby' | 'standby:<k>'
STRESS_SETUPS = ['standby', 'standby:1', 'standby:2', 'standby:3', 'standby:4']   // string k's "Standby" given, out of the mode, the turn armed;
  // 'standby:4' with the one-round magazine in. debug.js's SETUPS already lists them
drawStress(seed, lane) → [{ k, name, line: 7, keys, faces, holds, gapMs }]   // name 'calm' | 'din' | 'called' | 'bangs' | 'reload'; one threat a string
  // (COURSES.stress.draws.one on stream(seed, 'stress:pick', k)); string 4 also its second turner, keys[1], one of the two other lanes by
  // hash01(seed, 'stress:second'); holds by hash as pairs'; gapMs (the calm string's) on stream(seed, 'stress:gap', k, attempt)
planNoise(state, s) → [{ key, k, kind, atMs, … }]   // w (R.stress.plan); at the string's first arming, from its draw (whole ticks):
  // din:    kind 'horn' { atMs, untilMs } at the din's start and after every hornEvery-th blank; 'blank' { atMs, x, z } (the muzzle muzzleFwdM
  //         downrange of the coach), the first firstBlankMs in, then gaps intIn(stream(seed, 'stress:din', a, i), gapMs); the turn at the din's
  //         start + intIn(stream(seed, 'stress:noise', k, a), turnMs); the din's start a lead drawn on the same stream from leadMs
  // called: 'call' { atMs: burst − callMs } (the coach's "Bang!"), 'bang' { atMs, x, z, fromX, fromZ, throwAtMs } (PAIRS.bang's pad,
  //         as pairs' planBangs), the turn turnMs after the burst
  // bangs, reload: three 'bang' as pairs' planBangs on stream(seed, 'stress:noise', k, a), the turn turnMs after the third
  // calm: nothing; the turn at gapMs
stressActors(state, input, bus)    // w; lived ticks, from pairsActors when R.stress: each due event once (done: true): 'horn' dinOf each whole
  // second it sounds and the 'fx' horn on/off; 'blank' supp.shotNoise({ byId: coach, blank: true }) and the 'fx' blank; 'call' the coach's
  // speech (STRESS_COACH.call); 'bang' supp.bang({ byId: coach, call: the string's call or null }); the string's record (felt peak, pool peak,
  // the freeze as pairs' fireBangs keeps it); on string 4 the second turner (below). Events after the string's end are dropped (the coach stops)
stressStepStart / stressAfterStep  // from pairsStepStart / pairsAfterStep when R.stress: every rolled handling sub-step at felt ≥ BANG_FELT 20
  // into the string's steps (as Three bangs' R.bangs.steps); a RELOAD begun on string 4 sets reload.startMs and the second turn at
  // startMs + intIn(stream(seed, 'stress:turn2'), reload.turnMs); none by the first turn + reload.maxMs: it turns then
stressEnd(state, bus, s, why)      // at pairs' closeString when R.stress: the string's holes kept (str.holes, the truth for the card); the
  // exposure: a string finished (why 'stopped' | 'declared' | 'dry') at feltPeak ≥ INOC_FELT calls supp.noteExposure(state, pid,
  // { feltPeak, teacher: COURSES.stress.teacher }) and records { k, counted, why, would } (would: a fixed counter's "would count"); else
  // { counted: false, why: 'not finished' | 'not enough to teach' }
stressNow(state, ms) → null | { sheet, word, H, strings: [{ k, name, noise: 'calm' | 'din 30 blanks' | 'bang called' | 'three bangs' | …,
    feltPeak, band, poolPeak, frozeMs, takeInMs, fumbles: { tries, fails, drops, failed: [{ label, grade, felt }] }, breathe: { n, ms, shedPts },
    turnToFirstMs, seenToFirstMs, calmSeenToFirstMs, zones: { A, C, head, miss }, reload: { ms, tries, fails, drops } | null,
    second: { takeInMs, seenToFirstMs } | null, inoc: { counted, would, why } }],
  inoc: { pts, cap, would: n }, sessions: [...], summary }
  // summary: 'Boot recruit · 5 strings · froze 0 to 2.40 s · take-in 0.65 to 1.25 s · 3 fumbles, 1 drop · Breathe 2 · 7 A, 2 C, 2 miss'
againAsStress(state, tier) → { scenario: 'test-stress', seed, tier, setup: null }
```

**The hooks in pairs.js** (each guarded by `R.stress`, so test-pairs and "Three bangs" run to the tick): `drawStrings` → `drawStress`; `SEQ_PAIRS` → `SEQ_STRESS` through handling.js `seqOf` (`R.course === 'pairs' ? (R.stress ? SEQ_STRESS : SEQ_PAIRS)`); the course's data `COURSES.stress` where `C` is read (mags, draws, stringMaxMs, lullMag); `arm()` asks `planNoise` for the turn; `pairsActors` calls `stressActors`; `closeString` calls `stressEnd`; the step hooks call `stressStepStart` and `stressAfterStep`; `paperOf` and `paperText` take the stress fields (below); `bangDue` reads the stress plan too; `pairsWant`'s `'out'` and the arming's `!state.stop` count **a live Breathe as out of it and still** (`state.stop.doing.step === 'breathe'`), so breathing in the standby keeps the turn armed.

**The papers** (one helper, `paperText`; calm test-pairs papers unchanged to the character): string 1 as pairs'; string 2 leads `DIN 30 BLANKS · `; string 3 leads `BANG CALLED · FROZE 0.85 S · ` (FROZE only when a startle froze him); strings 4 and 5 lead `BANGS 3 · FROZE 2.40 S · `; `OFF SAFE ✗ ✓` after PAUSE TO FIRST on any noisy string (below rung 2; `OFF SAFE IN THE AIM` from rung 2, as built); string 5 adds `RELOAD 4.85 S ✗ ✓` (its tries, the time from its start to the bolt home) and `SECOND 1.15` (the second turner's take-in) before the zones.

**`src/sim/arms/marks.js`** (VIEWS §4.2's one helper, in the sim because belief is the sim's: §8 item 15):

```js
hitMarks(state, key, { k = null, phase = null } = {}) → null | { key, k, face, holds, phase: 'belief' | 'truth', marks: [{ n, shotId,
    called: [x, y], seen, hole: [x, y] | null, zone: 'A' | 'C' | 'head' | 'ring' | 'headDown' | null, part }], words, line }
  // k: the string (default the current, else the last ended); phase: 'belief' while the string runs, 'truth' from its end (the coach's
  // timer read: the debrief), unless given. Every round fired at that turner in the string, in order (n from 1):
  // called = aim + (hole − aim) × CALL_K + blur; aim the aimed zone's centre (A [0, 0], or the head [0, −30] for a head row); hole the
  // record's (a miss: aim + MISS_CALL_CM along a hash direction); CALL_K = clamp(MRK / CALL_MRK, CALL_K_MIN, 1); blur a hash direction
  // and radius × CALL_BLUR_CM × (1 − CALL_K) (hash01(seed, 'call', shotId, …): cosmetic, never the dice); seen: the round struck the face
  // (a puff at 7 m), drawn filled at its called point; belief gives hole and zone null; truth gives them all
  // words: belief 'PAIR · 2 SEEN', truth 'PAIR · A · C'; line (truth only): 'Two in the chest. He went down.' (never "dead")
```

### 2.3 What the face reads, and its numbers

**Reads**: `suppNow` (as built), `breatheOffer`, `stepsOf` (Breathe's row, `warn: 'up'`), the facts of §2.4 (`fx` horn, blank, bang; `breathe`; the coach's speech for "Bang!"), `rangeLook(state, ms).stress` (`{ coach: { x, z, face }, horn: { on, fromMs, untilMs } | null, blanks: [{ key, x, z, atMs }], bangs: [...as pairs'] }`), `hitMarks` (the card), `stressNow` (the end card, the papers), `inocOf`, `hardWord`, `againAsStress`. Felt is never a number on the HUD (as built): the end card and J carry the sum.

**The face's numbers** (my calls where not VIEWS'):
- **The din**: the coach holds an air horn (3 × 2 px, red) while it sounds and a short rifle at his hip, muzzle downrange; each blank a muzzle flash `BLANK_FLASH_R_M` 0.15 m for `BLANK_FLASH_MS` 30 (at least one frame, on the first frame at or after `atMs`, the fog's flag as the bang's), no hole, no brass drawn (blanks' brass is the coach's). The vignette, ducking and "! shaking" as built by felt.
- **The called bang**: the coach's line "Bang!" in the radio box as his speech, captioned "[a shout: Bang!]"; the throw, flash, light pool and smoke as built.
- **Breathe**: its row "Breathe · 4.0 s"; while it runs the panel's ticks in · hold · out · hold, the breath on the body bus slowed to its four counts; the picture eases as the pool drains (the vignette by band, as built: no new filter).
- **The sound** (`src/ui/audio/stress.js`; recipes in `sounds.js`): the horn (two detuned 440 / 554 Hz sawtooths through a 1.2 kHz formant, at the coach's hand), through the electronic ear defenders' limiter −20 dB low-passed at 2 kHz; each blank's report as the R-7's at 0.9 m (no crack, no strike), through the defenders' gate (−25 dB, 2 kHz, as built); the bangs through the defenders (gated, no whine: `hearingOf` is not deaf).
- **The hit card** (VIEWS §7.7, look A until the user scores the samples): a new rectangle `HITCARD`, 200 × 200 at `--ui` 1, at the top centre **left of PAPER** (the coach's timer keeps PAPER exactly as built), in the weapon and walking states of the stress course; drawn at whole device pixels a card pixel. The turner's painted man as the doll in colour (PERSONNEL's and the inventory's drawing, front view, head to mid-thigh, `HIT_PX_PER_M` 96, what the face holds in his hands), the man-target's zones over it at 25%, `manToCard()` mapping the 46 × 76 cm silhouette onto the doll's figure. **Belief** (during the string: at the pause after a round on him, and held `HIT_HOLD_MS` 6,000 out of the mode): every round a hollow 5 × 5 ring at its called point, a seen one filled, numbered in order; words `PAIR · 2 SEEN`. **Truth** (from the string's end to the next "Standby"): the holes as 3 × 3 marks numbered in order, coloured by zone (A, C, head, the plate's ring), the calls under them at 30%, the words `PAIR · A · C` and the line. Two turners hit on string 5: the card follows the brackets' pick; tabs under it, newest first. The end card (the hot wash): a row of five small truth cards, a string each.
- **The samples** (`samples/hitcard/`): one string's marks (a Pair to the chest, a third round high, a miss; recorded data, belief left and truth right) in **A** the doll in colour, **B** the khaki man-target board (the outline and kit in its two tones, holes in ink), **C** the casualty card's front and back outlines; each at the card's size for 1024 × 768, 1600 × 900 and 1920 × 1080 (`--ui` 0.85, 1, 1.2): nine views, whole picture pixels, shot by `node tools/gallery.mjs hitcard`.
- **The picker** opens on the Boot recruit with the hardening words (Three bangs' picker); **the end card**: `stressNow().summary`, a line a string (noise, felt peak and band, froze, take-in, fumbles, Breathe, first round from the sighting against calm by the book, zones, the RELOAD), the inoculation line ("Inoculation: strings 2, 4 and 5 would each count +1 in a career, to 15 at the cadre's course; a test sheet stays at 2."), the session's sheets side by side, "Again as …" each sheet leading with its hardening word; **Copy my scores**: `OLYMPUS v0.0.10 · test-stress · seed 48213 · chaos 80 · contrast 80 · hands 80 · ★ no · note: none`.
- **The bench** `?bench=stress-din`: `standby:1` on seed 48213 as the recruit, 20 s: the horn and thirty blanks; median 60 fps, p95 ≤ 18 ms, no frame over 25 ms at a blank.

### 3.1 The fields

- **`actor.combat`** gains `breatheFromMs`, `breatheUntilMs` (the last Breathe's window; a cut sets its end) and `stressAtMs` (the last stress fold); absolute ms; absent read as none (no window; the fold from `suppAtMs`).
- **`armoury.range.stress`** (only on test-stress): `attempt`, `plan[]` (each `{ key, k, kind, atMs, done, … }`, `key` not `id`: tests/ids-check.mjs counts ids), `strs[]` (a record a string: §2.2's fields, `holes: [{ key, shotId, part, zone, at }]` copied at its end), `inoc[]`. The strings' own records stay pairs' (`R.strs`, `R.str`) with the paper's new fields.
- **Nothing else**: no new item (the horn and the blank rifle are the coach's look, §8 item 9), no person field, `skills.inoc` as built.

### 3.2 The upgrade (a v0.0.9 save loads)

**None is written** (BODY §2.5's rule): no window is no Breathe; no `stressAtMs` folds from `suppAtMs` (a v0.0.9 "Three bangs" save mid-pool gains its stress at its first fold, honestly); no `R.stress` is test-pairs. `tests/saves/` gains two saves **made by v0.0.9's own code** (`git worktree add /private/tmp/claude-501/olympus-build/r10/supp/base-v0.0.9 v0.0.9`): `v0.0.9-bangs-pause.json.gz` (Three bangs, the boot recruit at the banged pause, the pool up) and `v0.0.9-pairs-standby.json.gz` (calm test-pairs, the private, `standby:1`); `game-upgrade` loads every save, plays 600 ticks, re-saves each just loaded byte for byte.

### 3.3 What test-handling, test-range, test-pairs and "Three bangs" change

- **test-handling, test-range, calm test-pairs**: nothing, to the tick and the digest: no block is ever written there (the coach's blanks are the stress course's alone; the player's rounds post nothing), `R.stress` absent, Breathe never offered at felt 0. `scene-handling`, `scene-range`, `range-integration`, `scene-pairs` (v0.0.8's papers pinned) unchanged on 48213, 7 and 99.
- **"Three bangs"**: its bots to the tick, its papers, card summaries and last ticks equal to v0.0.9's (scene pins them from the base worktree in `scene-bangs`). **Two things move, on purpose**: the body's stress rises by felt's band (about +12 for the boot recruit, 0 for the tier one: the digest moves, the rolls do not unless stress reaches 50, which `scene-bangs` asserts it does not); and **Breathe's row and the DI's offer appear there** when felt is 20 or more (one model on both bays; the pairs bot never presses it). Said in CHANGELOG.

## 5. Tests

Every test prints its numbers indented six spaces; names are sentences about the behaviour, with the user's words and date where a test pins their ask; assertions carry their evidence. A bound that is my estimate is a target: a role whose model disagrees prints its number, sets the bound with the reason, and says so.

### 5.1 supp

- **`supp`** (extended, quick): prints each new posting from the code: a blank 0.9 m from the head in the open, bare and in defenders (2, 1.2), indoors (4, 2.4) and the room's 1 at 4 m (0.6); the din a second (0.5, 0.3); a bang forewarned by a heard call in defenders (21.6), the call unheard beyond `DEAF_VOICE_M` while deafened (unprepared), a call 3.1 s before (unprepared); the din string's plan replayed on seed 48213 (the pool at the turn and at its end); the stress fold against a tick-by-tick reference. Fails: BLANKS_K applied to a blank's report; ear defenders not ×0.6 on the muzzle and the din; the shooter's own blank posting to himself; a closed form off its reference by 0.01; lived and skipped pools or stress gains differing by more than 0.01; any posting in a calm test-pairs or test-handling run (the block absent at its end).
- **`breathe`** (new, quick): from pool 105 exposed, plain decay against Breathe begun 3 s after the last input: the gap after 4 s is 8.00 (cover rate would be 16: printed, not built); a Breathe begun in the grace drains only past it; cut by a sighting at the end of its second sub-step: 4.00 and the fact `cut`; cut by a startle; the row at felt 19 absent and at 20 present, "! he's up" with a threat facing, fixed on the first page without one; its time 4,000 ms at felt 98 (no `timeK`); refused while startled and in a window; out of the mode the live step keeps the stress course's turn armed; a save at Breathe's start + 1, + 20 and + 60 ticks loading to the same digest and tick.
- **`inoc`** (new, quick; SKILLS §6.8): a sheet with `fixed: false` given 12 drills at felt peak 25 with teacher `cadre`, 4 a sol over 3 sols: 6 → 10 → 14 → 15, then capped; `unit` capped at 10; felt 19 never counts; a fixed sheet never moves (`why 'test sheet'`); no teacher never counts. Prints the counter after each drill. And the scene's call: a test-stress run's `R.stress.inoc` (strings that would count) on the recruit and the tier one.
- **`supp-body`** (new, quick; BODY §9.3): the stress gained over Three bangs and over test-stress's strings 4 and 5 by sheet (recruit about +12 and +13, tier one 0); `stressGainOf` against a 1 ms reference; frayed (75) taking 5 off hardening when forced. Fails: a gain at felt under 45; a tier one's stress moving under three bangs in defenders.

## 8. Resolutions, and doc changes for the lead

Implementation by TECH §1.3, the rest by DESIGN.md and the user's rules; each (my call) unless a source is named.

1. **Three roles**: supp (the model's new postings, Breathe, the stress, the counter), scene (the course, its noise, the card's data, `hitMarks`, the DI), face (the picture, the sound, the cards, the hit card and its samples).
2. **test-stress runs on pairs.js's engine** with `R.course = 'pairs'` and `R.stress` selecting its strings, sequence and noise: forty places read the pairs course, and a new course id would have to touch each; every hook is guarded by `R.stress`, so test-pairs and "Three bangs" run to the tick. The new module `stress.js` holds what is the stress course's own.
3. **Every string at 7 m**, one threat a string; string 5's second turner on another lane (alert, 23.2° off the muzzle). The noise strings' turns come from their noise (the din's drawn moment, 2 s after a bang), the calm string's from its gap.
4. **The din in the open uses COMBAT §5.1 as built** (the bay is outdoors: a blank's report 2, shots in the room 0), so the coach fires thirty blanks rapid, not ten, and sounds the horn as the din (0.5 a second): about 21 at the turn and 32 at its end. COMBAT §25.18.3's T14 (pool 25 from ten blanks at 4) used the indoor figure; the lead reprints it from `scene-stress`.
5. **The coach's blanks are the only shots posted**: `shotNoise` is built for every shot but called by the stress course alone; the player's own rounds would put the coach at his shoulder on test-pairs into the chaos and move its digest for nothing he reads.
6. **BLANKS_K is not applied to a blank's report**: COMBAT §5.1's ×0.5 is the harness's near-miss tone in place of a crack ("physics, not a discount"); a blank's muzzle blast is a muzzle blast.
7. **String 3's bang is forewarned, not prepared** (the task's "Bang!"; COMBAT §5.1's table: forewarned is "heard 'Bang!'", prepared is "Bang out!" and your team's): COMBAT §25.18.3's "Bang out!, prepared" gave 9 points and nothing to see; forewarned gives the recruit a short flinch (about 0.85 s) and nobody else, which is the lesson. The forewarning needs the call heard (`hearsVoice`, its first reader): in ear defenders, always.
8. **Ear defenders stay on** (COMBAT §24 question 23's default, the user's answer): ×0.6 on every bang, blank and horn, no deafness, no whine; the bangs still pin the recruit.
9. **No new range piece is placed**: the horn and the blank rifle are the coach's hands, drawn from `rangeLook().stress`; the bangs use `PAIRS.bang`'s pad (1.5 m behind, where §25.18.3 said 2 m: the points are equal inside 5 m). The places goldens do not move.
10. **The one-round magazine** (my call against §25.18.3's "one of two rounds"): with one up the spout, a Pair locks the bolt back every time, so the RELOAD under the chaos happens on every run; the second turner turns 1.5 to 2.5 s into the RELOAD (the hardening design's question 9: yes on test-stress), or 10 s after the first turn if no RELOAD came (never a dead end).
11. **Breathe is fixed at 4 s, no roll, never × `timeK`, the same for every sheet** (COMBAT §5.2: "the rate does not depend on the man"; breathing is not the hands); the task's "its time by skill" is not taken, since a skill-scaled Breathe would count Warfighting a third time; the hardened gain by needing it less. Four sub-steps of 1 s so a sighting or a startle cuts it within a second. Never a free reset: 4 s of your time for 8 points exposed.
12. **Breathe is offered where the model allows it** (felt 20 up, no window, not startled): a fixed row with nothing facing you, a marked single ("! he's up") with a threat up, never struck; the DI offers it only with nothing facing. It appears in "Three bangs" too, one model on both bays; the pairs bot never presses it.
13. **Out of the mode Breathe is a live step**, which the pairs engine counts as out of it and still, so a breath in the standby keeps the turn armed; a sighting cuts it.
14. **The decay is exposed** (no cover field on the pad); Stay down is not on the bay (§7).
15. **`hitMarks` lives in the sim** (`src/sim/arms/marks.js`), not VIEWS' `art/doll/marks.js`: belief is the sim's, and the art draws what it is given.
16. **Belief, then truth on the turners** (the user's answer to VIEWS question 22, DESIGN.md's log): during a string the called rings and the seen fills; the holes from the string's end (the coach reading his timer). VIEWS §7.7's "paper and steel the truth at once" is read as the range's 25 m card, which stays so.
17. **The called point** moves from the aim toward the hole with Marksmanship (`CALL_K`), blurred by hash: a novice calls his aim, an expert his hole. A seen mark is any round that struck the face (a puff at 7 m), drawn at its called point.
18. **The hit card's place**: a new rectangle `HITCARD` left of PAPER, so the coach's timer keeps PAPER as built and the debrief shows both; the end card carries a small truth card a string (the hot wash).
19. **The inoculation is fed at each finished noisy string** with the teacher `cadre` (SKILLS §6.8: "the range's stress course", cap 15); a string ended by time or passed over is not finished; a test sheet's counter never moves and the card says what a career would have counted.
20. **BODY §9.3's band term is wired** (suppressed 0.3, pinned 0.6 a second, in closed form, folded every 5 s of game time and at every input), through BODY's own `addStress`; it moves "Three bangs"' digest, not its rolls (asserted).
21. **The picker opens on the Boot recruit**; the score line keeps ROADMAP §2.2's form with the scene id `test-stress` and its three aspects.
22. **A bench for the din** (`stress-din`): thirty flashes and the horn, no frame over 25 ms at a blank.

Merged in the sheet's order (supp, scene, face) with no conflict; each (my call) unless a source is named.

23. **`game-domains` pins Breathe** (`breathe: 'weapons'`, 0.0.10 named in the test), as the three roles asked.
24. **T on a reach line does the reach** (the scene role's report): `instinct/range.js stepOfAct` read every '@' as a tempo, so `stop:reach@p3` and `stop:reach@ground` asked the step 'reach' at the tempo 'p3' and the panel refused it, on test-pairs since v0.0.8 too. Now a tempo is read after '@' only when the steps know it (normal, rushed, careful, steady). New `instinct-reach`: the parse, and over whole courses (the stress bot and the pairs bot, recruit and private, three seeds) 9 reach lines met, T did all 9 (0 without the fix). The stress bot's own workaround stays (it presses the row) with its comment corrected.

One "Three bangs" paper of v0.0.9 was cut too (the recruit on seed 1: 140 → 155 px); the 249 other Pairs and "Three bangs" papers of 25 runs stay 140 px. `ui-stress` asserts every line's foot inside the paper.

Calm test-pairs (15 runs), test-handling (3) and test-range (2) were compared with v0.0.9 to the digest: equal.

## 10. The fixer's

After the code, runtime and design reviews of the round; each (my call) unless a source is named, overrulable.

29. **Breathe's shed is the pool under the same run without it** (the code review): `supp.js pool` keeps the gap so far on the block (`breatheShedPts`, null once the end is written) before an input rewrites the record, carried × (1 − pts / SUPP_MAX) through the saturating add; `breatheEnd` adds the window's part since and reports it; `shooting.js endStep` keeps it on the step, and `stress.js` reads it there (one formula; `shedOf` gone). A blank 2 s into a Breathe: 4.96 shed (1 before), a bang: 2.80 (0 before); `breathe` pins both against the twin run.
30. **Belief on the toasts** (the runtime review; the user's answer A, "belief then truth"): while a string of the stress course runs, a round at a turner toasts "Marksmanship n against m · seen to strike." or "not seen." (main.js `beliefNow`); J keeps the zone.
31. **The hit card painted at its box's whole pixels** (the runtime and design reviews): `cardSize(ui)` 200 from --ui 1, down to 170 at 1024 × 768, `hitFit` returning the size; the figure from `figTop` (14 at 200, 6 at 170), the words' strip as tall as its rows (`wordsRows`: the headline in up to two rows, the coach's line in up to three, both at WORDS_K 2), each mark's number placed by `tagPlaces` clear of the others by 2 px. The doll stays at 96 px a metre, head to mid-thigh (the design review's 2× crop to the waist not taken: it would cut the man-target's C zone and its low hits; the line and the numbers were what could not be read). The goldens of the three looks re-set on purpose.

From the second sheet on a seed the session's grid (`sessionGrid`, page memory) in place of a summary line a sheet. The card for "Bang" is wider (680 × --ui) with its choices in two columns, so nothing scrolls at 1600 × 900 or 1024 × 768 with two sheets.
